pages.title: A Very Small Titan
pages.text: Choose one little titan and finish its own taming route.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Remnant Skull creates Modern Remnant, tamed with a Sniffer Egg. Netherite Effigy creates Ministrosity, tamed with a Lava Power Cell. Obtain both summon paths normally; this quest does not award them.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: The two little titans have different summon/tame items: Skull+Sniffer Egg and Effigy+Lava Power Cell.
